newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN sees 96/97 full year earnings steady. [CORRECTED 09:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EVN sees 96/97 full year earnings steady. [CORRECTED 09:20 GMT]

text.p: Austrian regional utility company Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich (EVN) said on Tuesday pre-tax profit in the first quarter fell (Corrects from rose) 6.5 percent and that it expected steady 1996/97 full year earnings.
EVN's full year ends on August 31, 1997.
"Due to the continuance of our effective cost management, we expect full-year earnings to be around the same level as the previous year's," EVN said in a statement without giving details.

In the first three months, electricity sales rose 2.4 percent to 1.446 GigaWatt hours, gas sales fell 6.8 percent to 343 million cubic metres, and heating sales jumped 18.6 percent to 121 GigaWatt hours.
